item.title: Juukishi Cutie ☆ Bullet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: EFFORDOM SOFT
  • 発売日: 2014-03-28
  • スコア: 6.640000000000001/10 (130 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 銃騎士 Cutie☆Bullet
  • 英語名: Juukishi Cutie ☆ Bullet

あらすじ

The story revolves around an organization, the Musketeers, tasked with maintaining peace within the kingdom. Among them is Fujikura Ayato, a dedicated musketeer of the White Rose Academy, serving as the deputy chief under his sister (!), Miyabi.

Despite the absence of blood ties, the team operates like a family, united in their battle against the lurking evils in the royal capital, Louvre. Their lives, though busy, are filled with purpose. However, this harmonious existence is abruptly disrupted when the dissolution of the White Rose Academy is announced.
